reason: All funding rounds described in this article are for European companies (Mistral in Paris, Nscale, Helsing, Quantum Systems, Neko Health in Stockholm, Tekever in Lisbon, Multiverse Computing in Spain, Wonderful in Amsterdam, The Exploration Co. in Bayern, Lovable in Stockholm, Euclyd in Eindhoven, Gravis Robotics in Zürich, Proxima Fusion in Munich, Olix in London, Callosum in London, Microagi in Munich).
